urls.title: Does Gender Matter? Female Representation on Corporate Boards and Firm Financial Performance - A Meta-Analysis
Does Gender Matter? Female Representation on Corporate Boards and Firm Financial Performance - A Meta-Analysis

performance is mixed, several researchers have conducted meta-analyses, which utilize a statistical approach to combine the results from multiple studies in order to increase their combined statistical power (over individual studies), improve estimates of the size of the effect, and resolve uncertainty when reports disagree. This report synthesizes the results from two meta-analysis studies. The first meta-analysis focuses on the relationship between women on boards and firms’ financial performance, while the second study focuses on the relationship between women on boards and firms’ social performance.
